Question: Assalamoalaikum Mohtaram weather Mehdvi are muslims or not and nikah of a muslim Faruqi girl with mehedvi pathan man is valid or not and if such nikah takes place what is its validity. Answer ID: 8728 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1411/1180=L/1429) The Mehdavis are out of Islam, any Muslim girl can not marry a Mehdavi boy.
